summary_1line: Sanjaya rebukes Dhritarashtra for past failures that led to war and says lamenting now is useless as fate and earlier choices sealed the calamity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Blind king Dhritarashtra sits in grief while Sanjaya stands before him delivering stern words about the causes of the war.
Sanjaya recounts how Krishna turned away in disappointment after realizing Dhritarashtra had abandoned the duties of a just king.
